methodology.timing: 100 real length/item/namedItem operations on prepared public collections. Live includes one attribute invalidation per operation. Module startup, fixture creation, validation, close and explicit GC are excluded. Each row retains one unchanged owner across warmup and measured samples.
methodology.paths: children and form.elements exercise generic JS query snapshots and typed transport construction on each live refresh. document.forms is the native getElementsByTagName transport control.
methodology.correctness: Assert exact checksum, every element identity, ordered named-property presence, native enumeration activity, native named reads for base HTMLCollection, and exact native query refresh count after every sample. Full fixture hashes must match all processes/stages.
methodology.limits: Finite synthetic measurements on one machine; no peak memory, cold import or full-suite speed claim. The fix captures one intrinsic realm per loaded module, independent of DOM owners.
